Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth years by using two-digit abbreviations ('50 and '69), effectively treating 1869 as 1969. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Julia Crawford Ivers (born 1869) was born later than T. V. Chandran (born 1950) and to an incorrect 19-year difference. The correct comparison shows 1950 is later than 1869, so Bhoomiyude Avakashikal’s director was born later.
